test_adb_controller_init_server: test the AdbController init_server method to verify adb devices command execution with timeout
test_adb_controller_restart_server: test the AdbController restart_server behavior when an adb command fails and retries after server restart
test_adb_controller_invalid_command: test the AdbController execute_command method to verify it raises AdbControllerError on invalid commands
test_adb_controller_env_vars: test the AdbController initialization to verify it deletes or retains ANDROID_HOME and ANDROID_ADB_SERVER_PORT env vars
test_adb_controller_avoid_recursion: test the AdbController to verify it raises AdbControllerError and avoids infinite recursion on persistent failures
